convention_rule: Zero-shot guess: of four identical objects in a row, the single green-lit one marks a position; position k (left to right) maps to candidate Pk in ID order.
basis: A: four barns, only the leftmost glows green. B: four hay bales, only the leftmost lit green by a lantern. Both mark position 1 of 4, so P1. Listed order would give P3, but P3 is the client-correct pick (qualifies, lowest energy 3), so it cannot be the target; P1 is consistent.
